rootCause: Field review showed the route was not entering an expressway at all; previous work focused on coloring/classification rather than the route-choice control itself.
The old vehicle setting used inverse wording (avoid tollways) and was buried in settings, while the MAP had no direct route-mode control.
OFF previously avoided tollways only, not highways explicitly, and ON did not explicitly request fastest routing.
scope: Add compact MAP 高速 ON/OFF control inside the existing map tools without changing page layout.
Use the same persisted routeVehicle.avoidTolls value as vehicle settings; no duplicate preference state.
Vehicle settings now present the same option positively as 高速道路を使う.
ON persists avoidTolls=false, requests preference=fastest, and allows highways/tollways.
OFF persists avoidTolls=true and avoids highways+tollways+ferries.
Toggling with an active route immediately cancels stale geometry and recalculates.
FINAL.29 tollway classification/coloring, fullscreen PIN interaction, vehicle dimensions/weight, Analytics, DB/schema, tasks, orders, visits and user data remain unchanged.
